title: claim-anchor/v1
description: One evidence observation in a project's Evidence Ledger (evidence/claim-anchors.ndjson): a verbatim source passage selected to support, contradict, or qualify an output claim, captured at claim finalization. Identity is source-side (cite_key + quote + locator) so prose rewrites do not mint new anchors. Protocol: skills/_shared/evidence-ledger.md.

anchor_id.description: <cite_key lowercase>-<sha1(cite_key|quote_sha256|source_loc)[:8]>. Lowercase, no dots (regex-inert vs anchor-verify numeric grammar). Append helper dedups on this: first capture wins.

claim_text.description: First-use snapshot of the prose/map-cell this passage was captured for. ADVISORY — not identity. Authoritative bindings: <!--ev:--> tags in drafts, anchor_ids[] in evidence/claim-inventory.json, anchor_refs[] in audit records.

claim_loc.description: Advisory locator at capture time (inventory row_id like '4c-established-3', or file:line).

evidence_quote.description: VERBATIM source passage, <=60 words. null is legal with access_tier T3/T4 + evidence_form metadata_only — it makes 'cited on metadata alone' visible.

evidence_context.description: Optional +/-1-2 surrounding sentences, <=150 words. RECOMMENDED for direction/magnitude/population claims.

evidence_form.description: What the quote IS, independent of how it was reached. KG-derived text is kg_paraphrase, never presented as a source quote.

quote_sha256.description: sha256 of the normalized quote (lowercase, collapsed whitespace). Integrity/dedup only — never sole identity.

access_tier.description: Tier chain per .claude/agents/verify-claim-faithfulness.md. Tier-honest capture: record the best evidence already in context; escalation to T0-T2 is the Phase-8 audit's job.

produced_by.description: The skill that filed the anchor, or the delegated Phase-2 reader identity (reader-batchN) — readers file anchors directly under the records-json contract (RCA Round 2 #10b, real-project eval 2026-08-22)

phase.description: Orchestrator phase at capture ('2', '7', '8'); absent/null on standalone runs.

supersedes.description: anchor_id this record corrects. Renderer and gates take the latest record per anchor_id.
